title: Warped area-minimizing hypersurface and warped product metric
summary: Several metric splitting theorems under spectral Ricci curvature lower bounds have been established in recent years, yet the existing literature mostly yields only isometric direct product decompositions. In some parameter regimes, direct product splitting is even known to fail. In this paper, we study warped (weighted) area-minimizing hypersurfaces and use their variational properties to prove local warped product metric splitting under spectral Ricci curvature conditions.
